title: HDMI source, TMDS mode (educational slice): 640x480@60 timing, TMDS 8b/10b video, control periods with preambles, TERC4 data islands carrying the AVI and SPD InfoFrames, serialised 1 bit per clock

regs.name: STATUS
regs.desc: Video timing (the same levels as the hsync / vsync / de pins)

irqs.name: HPD_LOST
irqs.desc: hpd went low after the link had run; level in the core, so the bit is set again on every clock until hpd returns

notes: The link runs on its own from the internal demo pattern while hpd is high; hpd low stops the TMDS outputs and restarts the timing at pixel (0,0) on return.
hpd (in) and tmds_clk / tmds_d[2:0] (TMDS clock and data channels, 1 bit per clock, pixel period 10 clocks) pass through unchanged; hsync / vsync / de also stay pins.
